appearance.summary: The look of the navigation (decision C97): field, |‹ ‹ [3] из 12 › ›| for a dense table; numbers, ‹ 1 … 4 [5] 6 … 12 › with up to seven places (five below the sm step) for sites, catalogues and search, links with href; arrows, ‹ Назад · Страница 3 · Далее › where the count is not known; cursor, «В начало · Дальше ›» for a cursor list, never a last page; more, «Показать ещё 20» with «Показано 40 из 240» and a thin bar. A control at an end is disabled, never removed, so the row keeps its width. Not written: the compatible footer of 1.4 (range «41–60 из 240», the page-size button «По 20 ▾», the field, Show more on its own line, the band), until 2027-01-01 (change journal value-pagination-footer-parts-to-view); a list composes those parts itself.

count-known.summary: Whether the number of records is known. A host that does not count every answer sets it false, and the view offers the number instead of showing it.

total-exact.summary: false when total is an estimate: the row reads «~N», the last page and the page count are not offered as exact, and the count link asks for the number (vocabulary 1.1.5 total-exact; gate 29)

can-count.summary: Whether the host can count on request. Without it the view offers nothing and asks for nothing.

counting.summary: A count is on its way; the view shows a short wait in place of the number.

has-next.summary: Whether a further page exists. It is what moves forward and Show more when no total was sent.

show-count-label.summary: Text of the control that asks the host for the number. Empty: the text of the page's language ("Show the number" in English).

counting-label.summary: Accessible name of the short wait shown while the count is on its way. Empty: the text of the page's language ("Counting" in English).

first-label.summary: Accessible name and tooltip of the control that goes to the first page. Empty: the text of the page's language ("First" in English).

page-field-label.summary: Label of the field that takes a page number. Empty: the text of the page's language ("Page:" in English).

show-more-busy.summary: Mark the Show more control as working while the host fetches the next portion; it is disabled and shows a loader.

size.summary: The step of the size ladder its fields, buttons, labels and page numbers take: 1, or the dense 1/2 of an admin.

href.summary: The address of a page as a template, {page} for its number and {page-size} for the page size («?page={page}»). Set, the arrows are links with rel prev/next and a page typed in the field is opened by its address; a listener that cancels sf-pagination-change takes the move in place and the link is not followed. Empty: the arrows are buttons.

page-param.summary: The name of the address's query parameter that holds the page («page»). Set, the page is read from the address when the element is placed and on Back and Forward (reported as sf-pagination-change), and a move writes it as a new history entry; page 1 is the address without it. Empty: the address is not touched.

page-in-title.summary: Add the page to the document title («Новости — Страница 3»); page 1 and a removed element leave the title as it was. One pagination of a document says it.

current.summary: the page being read, from 1 (vocabulary 1.1.5 page)

size-change.summary: Deprecated until 2027-01-01 (decision C97, change journal value-pagination-footer-parts-to-view): sent by the compatible footer's page-size menu; a list that composes «По 20 ▾» sends its own.

go-to-page.summary: Moves to a page: the number is parsed as an integer and clamped to 1..pageCount when the count is known (only to at least 1 when it is not). Emits sf-pagination-change when the page actually changes; does nothing when the total is a known zero.

show-more.summary: Emits sf-pagination-load-more with the current paging and the given item; performs no request and changes no state.

x-summary: Page navigation for a collection split into pages, in five appearances: field (a dense table), numbers (sites, search), arrows (an unknown count), cursor (a cursor list) and more (Show more).
x-renamed: events.sf-action-change → action-change (the DOM name without sf-<tag>-)
events.sf-action-for-all-change → action-for-all-change (the DOM name without sf-<tag>-)
events.sf-page-change → change (the DOM name without sf-<tag>-)
events.sf-page-size-change → size-change (the DOM name without sf-<tag>-)
events.sf-selection-clear → selection-clear (the DOM name without sf-<tag>-)

events: every old name keeps its old detail (component, tagName, template and the camelCase fields) through a split row; the new details carry data only, in the vocabulary's kebab-case (page-size, page-count, has-next, selected-count, action-for-all)
events.apply: actionForAll → scope (selection | filter), vocabulary §5 apply
settings.page-size, total, selected-count: numbers with integer and min (vocabulary 1.1.5 page-size)
x-decisions: shape: leaf, with reasons. The checkbox, the dropdowns and the page field are drawn by its template as controls of the pagination's own settings (action-for-all, page-size, action, the typed page); no rule runs between them, so keys, roles and rules would restate the same three bindings. And the parts it would place (sf-checkbox, sf-dropdown, sf-input) are migrating in the field family's branches now: an assembly binds to their 1.3.8 interfaces, which this branch does not have (report.md order check: an assembly moves after its parts). The assembly is a later step once the field family has landed.

version: 1.0.1 → 1.1.0, a minor while the eight old event names hold dated aliases (§4.10). 1.1.0 → 1.2.0, a minor: the setting total-exact (an estimated total reads «~N», gate 29), and size-change's page-count is null when the count is not exact, as change, load-more and apply already say.

events: names by vocabulary 1.1.5 -- sf-page-change → sf-pagination-change {current, …}, sf-page-size-change → sf-pagination-size-change, sf-count-request → sf-pagination-count (§5 count), sf-show-more → sf-pagination-load-more {direction: after, …} (§5 load-more), sf-selection-clear → sf-pagination-selection-clear (an own verb), sf-action-change and sf-action-for-all-change → sf-pagination-action-change and -action-for-all-change, sf-action-apply → sf-pagination-apply {action, scope} (§5 apply). The migration's row to the bare `change` is corrected: a DOM change would also be heard from the page-size and action dropdowns inside.

detail-adapter: §8 takes the element out of detail, so each new name carries data only; each old name follows once with its old detail (component, tagName, template, camelCase fields; apply's actionForAll, load-more's item) through a split row and sfAliasAdapters. sf-data-view (ui-pro data-view index.js:1952-1982) listens to the old names and keeps working until it moves.

change reports a person (§8): the page buttons, the field, the arrows and the dropdowns are a person's; goToPage, lastPage and setPageSize keep sending their events when a host calls them, because the host calls them to finish what a person started -- sf-data-view jumps to the last page once the count it asked for arrives (data-view index.js:1878). Writing current or page-size as a setting sends nothing, as before.

x-target: page, has-more, selection and state are not added: current is the page (vocabulary 1.1.5 binds the key page to it), has-next says what has-more would, and the pagination holds no selection or data state (the rows do, selected-count is their count). query is not added: the source reads change and size-change. total-exact is added in 1.2.0 (gate 29): count-known says whether there is a number at all, total-exact whether the number is exact; sf-data-view sets it from the port's total_exact.

actions: go-to-page {page} answers an outcome (applied; refused empty, invalid, current) and show-more answers applied (§4.4); firstPage, lastPage, goToTypedPage, setPageSize, setAction, setActionForAll, applyAction, clearSelection and requestCount stay the element's helpers.
own-verb-words: selection-clear is a verb of the pagination alone (the panel's cross); its word is lang events.selection-clear.label.

item-shape: the list settings stay strings in markup (page-sizes "10,20", actions "value:text::flags|"), as the template and hosts write them; the page items it draws are {type: page, value, selected, edge}.
existing-aliases: compatibility.migrations holds a changelog line (1.0.0 → 1.0.1), no alias; nothing to fold.
key-effects: native buttons, links and the page field: Tab reaches each, Enter and Space press a button, Enter in the page field goes to the typed page (select).
a11y-name: aria-label on the host, else the language file's runtime word «Страницы результатов» / «Result pages».
template: templates.default names the Lit template js/templates/default.js, the migration form §5.2 allows.
examples: examples.json from studio.fixture.json and studio.scenario.json plus the unknown count, the half size and the bulk panel; probe.json drives Tab, Enter and Space (gate 16).

css-variables: nine public variables read by the class sheets (component/pagination) over the role tokens (§6): the fill, the words' colour, the gap, the divider, a page number's fill, colour and radius, the current page's fill and colour. They are not in src/core/contracts/public-variables.v1.json yet: on the built bytes (tests/browser/public-variables.browser.mjs) only the fill, the words' colour and the gap reach sf-pagination; the page number's and the current page's variables style .sf-page-number, which the template no longer draws (the page field took the row of numbers), and the divider styles .sf-pagination-top, which it does not draw either. They enter the contract when they are pointed at what the element draws.
side-effects: none.
docs: docs/docs.md, where the folder keeps it (as sf-tooltip).

version 1.2.2: the first-paint snapshots are retaken: the JSON island is printed once (no held copy), the icon font's state (sf-icon loaded, sf-icon-loaded) is left out, a closed surface prints closed and a size or place the code measured (a non-zero px width, height, inset, clip or transform) is left out, so a snapshot is the same on every run.
version 1.2.3: the first-paint sheet list names the utility sheets its templates draw with (core.runtime 1.0.7 asks for them before the element draws: the style gate).

version 1.3.0: the page row publishes its box (standard 1.3.10 §5.4, a component publishes its box): --sf-pagination-block-size-1\/2 and -1 on :root, the control height of the step plus the row's padding above and below (--sf-space-1) and the line under it, from the tokens the row is drawn with; the row's min-block-size is the same sum, so a row of text alone is as tall as one with the arrows. They are outputs a page reads, not looks it sets (x-published), so the nine look variables stay the §6 count. The row measured 88 px at size 1 and 80 at 1/2 instead of 73 and 65 on a page that loaded a component sheet before core.css: the cascade layer order is the order a page first meets the names, and only core.css declared it (ui-builder fix/sheet-layer-order declares it in every sheet).

version 1.3.1: the bundle carries no element layer of its own -- element-manifest, aliases, the alias table, the host port, deprecations, page actions, the layer stack, the open-surface mark and the instance path come from the page's shared runtime (SF.runtimeModule, runtime ABI 1, core.runtime 1.1.0), one instance per page -- and embeds of this file only the keys the runtime reads. Behaviour unchanged.

version 1.3.7: the first-paint snapshots are retaken for sf-dropdown 1.6.0: the page-size dropdown's printed field carries the language's placeholder («Не выбрано»), which the chosen size covers; behaviour unchanged.

version 1.3.8 (2026-11-07): a patch, the first paint retaken (sf-dropdown 1.7.0, owner C05-C07, docs review R029): the page-size and bulk-action dropdowns' hidden lists carry their size class (sf-list--size-1/2). Nothing else drawn changes.

version 1.3.9 (2026-11-08): a patch, nothing drawn differently by this element. Its first-paint sheet list names the kbd sheet (component.kbd 1.1.0, docs review R030): sf-button 1.8.0 draws a shortcut's keys with it, and every component that draws an sf-button asks for it before the first paint. Settings, values, events and keys unchanged.

version 1.3.10: the sf-button and sf-button-icon it draws are asked for their current names (appearance ghost for link, status danger for error; actions block, decisions C13 and C15), so the template uses no dated alias; nothing it draws changes.

version 1.3.11 (2026-11-09): a patch, nothing drawn or done differently. The generated reference gives the action's method its one object argument, goToPage({page}), where it read the parameters one by one (standard §4.4: the parameters arrive as one object); the element's code also takes the value alone, goToPage(<number>), and the reference says so (x-registry.action-calls). Settings, values, events and keys unchanged.

version 1.3.12 (2026-11-09): a patch; nothing in the component changed. The sf-input it draws asks for the kbd sheet since sf-input 1.7.0 (C38, the shortcut setting; component.kbd 1.3.0), so its first-paint snapshots name that sheet and carry one more empty line where the field's shortcut would stand; the component takes a patch with them. Settings, values, events and keys unchanged.

version 1.3.13 (2026-11-10): a patch; nothing in the component changed. The sf-dropdown it draws shows its arrow glyph as sf-icon since sf-dropdown 1.8.1, so the first-paint snapshots follow; the component takes a patch with them. Settings, values, events and keys unchanged.

version 1.3.14 (2026-11-11): a patch; nothing in the component changed. The sf-button it draws writes sf-button--ghost beside the dated sf-button--link since sf-button 1.13.0 (CB-01), so the first-paint snapshots follow; the component takes a patch with them. Settings, values, events and keys unchanged.

version 1.3.15 (2026-11-12, pair next 3): a patch, nothing in the component changed. Its first-paint snapshots follow the components it draws (sf-dropdown 1.9.0 and the buttons it draws, as merged in this pair); the snapshot sheet lists are regenerated by scripts/snapshot-first-paint.mjs. Settings, values, events and keys unchanged.

version 1.4.0 (2026-11-12, study R182, defects PG-05, PG-10, PG-11): a minor. Three settings, all off by default: href, an address template that makes the arrows links with rel prev/next (and opens a typed page by its address; sf-pagination-change is cancelable for such a press, a cancel takes the move in place); page-param, the query parameter that holds the page, read on placing and on Back/Forward and written on a move; page-in-title, the page in the document title (word runtime.title-page). The last-page button is drawn only where the jump can be answered, the count exact or can-count: a host that cannot count (a cursor list) no longer gets a button that asked into nothing (PG-11). On a narrow screen the page row stays a row that wraps: the count and the arrows share a line and the page size keeps its label beside it, two lines where it took four (PG-05). Events, values and keys otherwise unchanged; the first-paint snapshots follow at the group build.

version 1.5.0 (2026-11-12, decision C97; study R182, defects PG-01..PG-04, PG-06..PG-09): a minor. sf-pagination is page navigation only, in five appearances (setting appearance, default field): field |‹ ‹ [3] из 12 › ›| (the field as wide as the longest page number, «из 12» after it), numbers ‹ 1 … 4 [5] 6 … 12 › (up to seven places, five below the sm step, the first and the last page always, the gap not a control, links with href and aria-current=page on the current one; with no exact count the row ends in a gap while has-next says more follow), arrows ‹ Назад · Страница 3 · Далее ›, cursor «В начало · Дальше ›» (no number, never a last page; Larena msg-0852f1a2), more «Показать ещё 20» with «Показано 40 из 240» and an sf-progress-bar (its own look, never in one row with the arrows). In every appearance a control at an end is disabled, not removed, so the row keeps its width while a person pages (PG-02). An element written without appearance draws the compatible footer until 2027-01-01, in the look of C97: the range «41–60 из 240» (words range, range-many; «из ~450» for an estimate) in place of «Всего: 240», the page size as a quiet sf-button «По 20 ▾» with an sf-menu-context of radio rows in place of the labelled select, the field with «из 12», Show more on a line of its own above the row, the band below; the parts it keeps for compatibility are noted in SF.deprecations (change journal value-pagination-footer-parts-to-view, value-pagination-show-more-to-more, setting-pagination-band-to-view, attribute-pagination-footer-labels). Words added: of-pages, range, range-many, page-size-text, previous-text, next-text, cursor-next-text, show-more-count, shown; show-count-label reads «посчитать» / «count». Relations cl-menu-context and cl-progress-bar. Events unchanged in name and detail; size-change and the band's events are deprecated with their parts. The first-paint snapshots follow at the group build.

item_contract.page: Positive one-based page number bounded by total and page-size.

navigation.const: The visible root is a named nav; page actions are native buttons because the component emits state events instead of owning URLs.

current.const: Exactly one rendered page exposes aria-current=page when total is greater than zero.

empty.const: A zero-sized collection renders no page controls and emits no page-change.

responsive.const: A long desktop range keeps edge pages and static ellipses; a narrow range keeps the current page, adjacent pages and directional actions on one line.

composition.const: Show-more, page-size and batch-action sections remain compatible optional compositions; data loading and host actions stay outside the component.

ai_guidance.use_when: Use sf-pagination for a collection divided into numbered pages when the host owns data loading and reacts to pagination events.
do_not: Do not copy generated ui-smart code
Do not move host data or access decisions into the component
Do not use Pagination for semantic steps or short content that can be shown at once
Do not make an ellipsis interactive or put the pagination row on multiple lines
Do not treat the optional batch-action section as the core pagination contract
ai_guidance.minimal_example: <sf-pagination aria-label="Страницы результатов поиска" current="2" total="96" page-size="10" top="false" bottom="false" show-page-size="false"></sf-pagination>

accessibility.focus: Tab reaches only enabled native actions. Focus uses the shared keyboard-only focus-visible treatment and remains visible in forced colors; omitted pages are not focusable.

changes: Fix: the action-for-all checkbox follows the checkbox state (change) instead of toggling on click, so clicking its label no longer toggles twice and leaves it off.

The page row publishes its box on :root: --sf-pagination-block-size-1\/2 and --sf-pagination-block-size-1 (2 x --sf-space-1 + the step's control height + 1px). The row's min-block-size is the same sum; nothing else is drawn differently.

item.description: What showMore was called with; the built-in button passes its click target.

getTopSection.summary: Returns the top section element (.sf-pagination-top), or null when it is not rendered.

getMainSection.summary: Returns the main section element (.sf-pagination-main), or null when it is not rendered.

getBottomSection.summary: Returns the bottom section element (.sf-pagination-bottom), or null when it is not rendered.

setPageSize.summary: Sets a positive page size, keeps the current page within the new page count and emits sf-pagination-size-change. A non-positive, non-numeric or unchanged size is ignored.

setAction.summary: Selects a batch action by value (an empty value clears the choice) and emits sf-pagination-action-change when it differs from the current one.

setActionForAll.summary: Sets whether the batch action applies to every record under the filter and emits sf-pagination-action-for-all-change. Turning it on also requests the count (sf-pagination-count with reason action-for-all) when the count is not yet known.

setState.summary: Writes each key as its kebab-case attribute: false, null, undefined or an empty string removes the attribute, true sets it empty, anything else is stringified.

onPageChange.summary: Adds a listener for sf-pagination-change; the handler is called with (current, detail, event). Ignores a non-function handler.

onShowMore.summary: Adds a listener for sf-pagination-load-more; the handler is called with (detail, event). Ignores a non-function handler.

aria-label.description: Accessible name of the navigation landmark. Empty: the text of the page's language ("Result pages" in English).
